text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- National mobilisation around referendum on constitutional reform due Sept 13.
- Fisheries sector wants a maritime chamber within parliament to fill legislative vacuum.
- Leaders of opposition parties to discuss referendum on constitutional reform.
- ONA group reinforces position after buying four mines from the state.
- Owners of fuel stations cancel strike they planned on Sept 23 after meeting Trade Minister Driss Jettou.
